title: Iterate narrowly, then run the attached full CI gate once
when: Before remote pytest iteration or the final review gate.
need: Targeted files/node IDs and bounded impacted selection support iteration. An unfiltered request covering every declared test root duplicates an available registered full CI gate and refuses before publication/dispatch. Follow the named attached requirement or its lookup for full verification; keep its native verdict. A conflicting landing PR with no covering run refuses before rebase: merge the base into the lane, resolve and commit, then let the normal gate publish the repaired head and rerun. An explicit expected SHA is checked before preparation; a clean gate rebase becomes the verified candidate and evidence retains the requested SHA. Empty effective keyword/marker expressions are unfiltered; nonempty filters and collection keep their routes.
surface: Wrapper help, routing refusal and verification rules
review: Source and fixture coverage only; post-deploy Command proof must exercise the candidate router with fake dispatch boundaries.
